title: Robot’s Gendering Trouble: A Scoping Review of Gendering Humanoid Robots and its Effects on HRI
reasoning: The paper is a scoping review that evaluates the ethical and social implications of gendering humanoid robots. It uses Gender Studies and feminist theory to critique the reinforcement of gender stereotypes and specifically addresses the domain of 'Roboethics' throughout the text, identifying ethical consequences for the field of Human-Robot Interaction.
